content.title: PureTech's Lung Disease Candidate Slowed Lung Function Decline In Idiopathic Pulmonary Fibrosis Patients
content.summary: PureTech Health plc (NASDAQ:PRTC) stock is up on Monday, after the company announced results from ELEVATE IPF Phase 2b trial of deupirfenidone (LYT-100) for idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis (IPF). The trial evaluated deupirfenidone at two doses three times a day (TID) over 26 weeks in IPF patients.
